episodes.title: The Vow
episodes.summary: Mary is a young, unwed girl pregnant with John Alden's baby in Salem, a Puritanicaltown. Believing her lover John was killed during King William's War, she is now faced with the Puritans' stocks and forehead branding, or giving her and John's child to the devil. Having chosen the latter, she marries the town's richest and most influential selectman George Sibley, claiming his wealth and power for herself by enslaving him. Reverend Cotton Mather is trying to stop witches from taking over America by killing them. John returns home to witness a witch-hunt, wherein Mary plans to use the trials to get Puritans to kill each other, allowing her to rule Salem.

episodes.title: The Stone Child
episodes.summary: Following the first death of the Grand Rite, Mary intends to sacrifice another innocent before the next full hunters moon in the form of a sign. Meanwhile, John works with Cotton Mather and Issac Walton in order to locate and stop the witches.

episodes.title: In Vain
episodes.summary: When Magistrate Hale discovers that it was Isaac who broke the witches circle, it's up to John to save him. A power struggle arises within the hive, forcing Mary to assert her authority with potentially deadly consequences.

episodes.title: Survivors
episodes.summary: A face from John's past comes to Salem, and Mary's plans nearly come apart when she loses control of Mercy Lewis. Elsewhere, Mary's most trusted ally, Tituba, is forced to deceive John in order to eliminate a threat that endangers her mistress.

episodes.title: Lies
episodes.summary: Following the discovery of The Malum, John acquires the help of Cotton to find out more about the Grand Rite. Mary tries to regain control of Mercy, and Tituba is tasked by the hive to finally discover the secret of John Alden that he has killed to keep.

episodes.title: The Red Rose and the Briar
episodes.summary: After successfully capturing Rose, John and Cotton plan to extract information on the Grand Rite from her during the planetary alignment with Saturn. Mary assists Mercy in becoming a witch, and initiates her into the hive.

episodes.title: Our Own Private America
episodes.summary: Mary rediscovers her passion for John, and her new apprentice Mercy could help accelerate the Grand Rite. Magistrate Hale tries to delay an possible threat to the hive. His daughter, Anne, becomes more suspicious of those around her.

episodes.title: Departures
episodes.summary: Upon his arrival, feared witch hunter Increase Mather wastes no time taking control of the witch hunt and Salem. Mary fears that Increase will discover her husband has been spelled, and enlists the help of Isaac to deter him from uncovering the truth.

episodes.title: Children, Be Afraid
episodes.summary: Mary must act quickly in order to prevent Increase from undoing the spell placed on her husband. Mercy and her followers prove themselves useful to the greater cause, and Cotton mourns over the banishment of Gloriana.

episodes.title: The House of Pain
episodes.summary: While Mary deals with Mercy's betrayal, Tituba must endure the torture inflicted upon her by Increase in his newly founded "House of Pain". Meanwhile, Anne stumbles upon one of her fathers artifacts and suddenly finds herself far from home.

episodes.title: Cat and Mouse
episodes.summary: With the help of Issac, Mary devises a plan that she hopes will rid her of both Mercy and Increase. John has been falsely accused of witchcraft and awaits trial, while Anne learns a dark truth about her heritage from her father.

episodes.title: Ashes, Ashes
episodes.summary: The trial of John Alden is held, with Increase as his prosecutor and Cotton as his defense. However, the ordeal brings a few unexpected secrets to light, and Mary is ultimately faced with a difficult decision.

episodes.title: All Fall Down
episodes.summary: Mary must choose between fleeing Salem with John or completing the Grand Rite, and Tituba reveals a long kept secret that could sway her decision. Meanwhile, Increase closes in on the witches, and the Hales prepare to go into hiding.

episodes.title: Cry Havoc
episodes.summary: Mary Sibley, the most powerful witch in Salem, faces both foreign and domestic challenges to her authority in the premiere of Season 2.

episodes.title: Blood Kiss
episodes.summary: Mary initiates the second act of the Grand Rite; Alden returns to Salem.

episodes.title: From Within
episodes.summary: A former foe helps Mary keep Salem in the witches' hands.

episodes.title: Book of Shadows
episodes.summary: Anne explores her supernatural side, while Mary receives a chilling warning.

episodes.title: The Wine Dark Sea
episodes.summary: Mary comes face-to-face with her tormentor Countess Marburg.

episodes.title: Ill Met by Moonlight
episodes.summary: Countess Marburg arrives in Salem and threatens Mary's stronghold on the city.

episodes.title: The Beckoning Fair One
episodes.summary: Mary and Countess Marburg keep up appearances while continuing their covert battle for Salem.

episodes.title: Dead Birds
episodes.summary: Countess Marburg's Achilles' heel is revealed.

episodes.title: Wages of Sin
episodes.summary: Mary and Wainwright grow closer; at the same time, the Starry Messenger comet approaches Earth; Anne continues to glean knowledge from her dead father's writings; and a long-brewing feud reaches a tipping point.

episodes.title: Til Death Do Us Part
episodes.summary: Alden faces his first test of fatherhood after he joins forces with Mary.

episodes.title: On Earth as in Hell
episodes.summary: Mary has a public fall from grace, while Alden and Cotton work together to save the Boy's soul.

episodes.title: Midnight Never Come
episodes.summary: The final countdown to the consecration begins.

episodes.title: The Witching Hour
episodes.summary: In the Season 2 finale, Mary plans a last-ditch effort to overthrow Countess Marburg; John receives a serious message from a pair of allies; Mercy faces the possibility of a scary future; and Anne ventures down a more destructive path.

episodes.title: After the Fall
episodes.summary: In the Season 3 premiere, the people of Salem come to the frightening conclusion that their only hope for surviving the hell that has risen is to raise the dead.

episodes.title: The Heart is a Devil
episodes.summary: Mary is hell-bent on keeping evil at bay when she leaves the comfort of Alden's arms.

episodes.title: The Reckoning
episodes.summary: Mary's penance for her betrayal takes a deadly turn while Cotton is forced to perform an exorcism of his own.

episodes.title: Night's Black Agents
episodes.summary: Cotton discovers life-altering news while Mary learns the power of her femininity.

episodes.title: The Witch is Back
episodes.summary: A traitor is exposed while a ghost from Salem's past makes a shocking appearance.

episodes.title: Wednesday's Child
episodes.summary: Mary and Alden have their love put to the ultimate test. Meanwhile, Anne becomes more deeply involved with dark magic.

episodes.title: The Man Who Was Thursday
episodes.summary: Loyalties are tested when Mary makes a dangerous move.

episodes.title: Friday's Knights
episodes.summary: Mortal enemies come together in order to keep all hell from literally breaking loose.

episodes.title: Saturday Mourning
episodes.summary: Everyone reveals their true colors and some hearts get broken in the process.

episodes.title: Black Sunday
episodes.summary: Survival is uncertain on the eve of Salem's demise.
